sections.html:
The Office of Practical Training is a core administrative unit of the university responsible for the comprehensive organization, planning, and monitoring of practical training for higher education applicants. Practical training serves as a fundamental, system-forming component that integrates theoretical knowledge with the continuous development of students’ professional competencies.

The Office of Practical Training reports directly to the First Vice-Rector.

sections.heading: Key responsibilities
sections.html:
• ensuring collaboration among dean’s offices, departments, guarantors of educational programmes, and educational management bodies;
  • establishing internship bases and concluding cooperation agreements with leading educational institutions, companies, and organizations;
  • supervising compliance with training schedules and evaluating internship outcomes;
  • coordinating the preparation of official orders, maintaining records, and summarizing analytical reports on practical training.
